title: SwapFaces.ai review: pricing, privacy and alternatives
summary: SwapFaces.ai review covering photo and video face swap, one-time credits, privacy, adult-content access, commercial use, and alternatives.
body_markdown:
## Quick answer


**SwapFaces.ai is worth considering for adults seeking one-time credits and long-form face-swap options.**


It offers photo, GIF, multi-face and video workflows; its API page currently requires contacting the company rather than self-service access. The main limitation is the service is adults-only and includes explicit-content tools, making it unsuitable for many teams. Magic Hour is the stronger fit when you want image, GIF and video face swap inside a broader image, video and audio workspace.


This vendor-authored review was checked against[SwapFaces.ai official product and policy pages](https://www.swapfaces.ai/) on September 20, 2026. Magic Hour publishes this guide and is included as an alternative. It is a documentation review, not a retained cross-tool quality benchmark.


## What is SwapFaces.ai?


SwapFaces.ai is an AI face-swap product for replacing a face in an image or video. It offers photo, GIF, multi-face and video workflows, and advertises an API that currently requires direct contact for access. Use only media you own or have permission to edit, and obtain explicit consent from every identifiable person.


## What SwapFaces.ai does well


Adults seeking one-time credits and long-form face-swap options. Its workflow removes much of the manual masking and compositing required by conventional editing. That convenience does not prove every output is accurate: inspect eyes, teeth, hairlines, skin edges, occlusion, lighting and identity across the full clip.


## SwapFaces.ai pricing and access


SwapFaces says paid credits are a one-time purchase and never expire. Its pricing page lists HD exports, commercial rights and a 30-day refund when no more than 20% of credits have been used. Unlimited plans cover specific tools rather than the full suite, so confirm which workflow consumes credits.


*Swapfaces pricing page, captured September 25, 2026. Billing selection, currency and any promotion are shown in the screenshot; recheck the live page and checkout before buying.*[View official source](https://www.swapfaces.ai/pricing)


## Privacy, consent and commercial use


The July 3, 2026 privacy policy says uploads and generated content are deleted within 24 hours, except content flagged by safety systems or reported by users. The service is restricted to adults and requires explicit consent for real-person material.


A commercial-use label does not clear publicity, copyright, trademark or contractual rights. Keep written consent, source licenses and disclosure records. Never use face swap to impersonate, deceive, harass or create intimate imagery without consent.

## How to test SwapFaces.ai fairly


Use one permitted portrait, one difficult side angle and one short motion clip. Keep resolution, duration and source files constant. Record attempts, processing time, charged credits, watermarks, export resolution and whether the output was usable without manual repair.


Reject outputs with identity drift, unstable jaw or hair boundaries, flicker, incorrect occlusion, changed expression, altered skin tone or artifacts around glasses and hands. Compare cost per accepted output rather than cost per generation.


## How to choose the right SwapFaces.ai workflow


Start with the media type. Use photo face swap for one still image, multiple-photo face swap when several identities appear in one frame, GIF face swap for short loops, and video face swap for moving footage. The[official product menu](https://www.swapfaces.ai/) also lists multiple-video, long-video and YouTube-video routes. These labels describe different jobs; they should not be treated as interchangeable credit costs or output limits.


For a group scene, map each source identity deliberately and inspect every person after processing. For video, test a short representative segment before uploading the full file. Include a head turn, blink, occlusion and lighting change so the sample exposes identity drift and boundary failures early.


### Before a long-video face swap


The dedicated[SwapFaces.ai long-video workflow](https://www.swapfaces.ai/long-video-face-swap) documents MP4, WebM and AVI uploads. Its interface separates trimming, adding a replacement face, Free to Preview, Fast Swap and HD Swap. Check the selected operation and displayed charge before processing a full clip; a preview label does not establish a free full-length HD export.


Download and check the result when it is ready. The privacy policy says ordinary uploads and generated files are removed within 24 hours of processing, with a separate exception for safety-flagged or reported content. Keep your own approved source and final export; do not treat the service history as a permanent archive.


## SwapFaces.ai free access, credits and unlimited plans


SwapFaces.ai’s[current pricing page](https://www.swapfaces.ai/pricing) separates one-time credit purchases from time-limited unlimited plans. It says purchased credits do not expire and that its refund policy can apply within 30 days when no more than 20% of credits have been used. Verify the exact pack, tools, output limits and refund conditions at checkout. Its pricing FAQ limits refunds to one per account; check the detailed refund policy and your checkout before relying on eligibility.


The same page says only video face swap and its adult-content tool are unlimited on Unlimited Pro; other tools still consume credits. It also describes some premium benefits as valid only during an active plan period. “Credits never expire” therefore should not be read as “every feature remains unlimited forever.”


For budgeting, record the displayed charge for photo, GIF and video separately. Count every retry and rejected result. A one-time payment can be preferable to a subscription for irregular work, but only if the unused balance applies to the workflows you actually need.


**Budget Quick Swap and HD Swap separately.** SwapFaces’[pricing FAQ](https://www.swapfaces.ai/pricing) says HD uses more credits per task. It advertises higher resolution and finer detail, but that is a vendor claim rather than our measured quality result. Check the displayed charge for the selected mode and same clip before running the full video; a free preview does not establish the final HD download cost.


### Refunds, missing credits and failed jobs are different


The[detailed refund policy](https://www.swapfaces.ai/refund) requires a request within 30 days and usage below 20% of purchased credits. It also lists completed outputs without a technical fault as non-refundable. The pricing FAQ instead says 20% or less, so obtain confirmation before relying on the exact boundary. Disliking a technically delivered result is different from a platform error.


For a platform-error failure, the policy describes restoring the charged credits rather than refunding money. The pricing FAQ directs users to Credit Records and asks for screenshots of the charge and processing error if a deduction was incorrect. For a cash-refund request, retain the account email, order or transaction ID, and reason. These are the vendor’s documented procedures, not a guarantee that every request qualifies.


## SwapFaces.ai API status


SwapFaces.ai advertises an[image and video face-swap API](https://www.swapfaces.ai/ai-swap-face-api) for single and multiple-face workflows. Its current API page says self-service access is not yet supported and asks prospective users to contact the company. Treat the API as sales-assisted until public authentication, endpoint, pricing and retention documentation are available.


Before integration, require written confirmation of input limits, face mapping, asynchronous job behavior, retries, billing, output retention, deletion, support and commercial terms. A marketing page is not a production API contract.


## Privacy and policy checks before upload


The[privacy policy](https://www.swapfaces.ai/privacy-policy) and[Terms of Use](https://www.swapfaces.ai/term-use) were both updated July 3, 2026. They identify TecDeon Limited as operator, restrict the service to adults and require explicit, documented consent for real-person material. The Terms say uploads and generated content are automatically deleted within 24 hours.


The pricing page makes a broader statement that uploaded media is not used for training or moderation, while the existing article notes exceptions in the privacy policy for safety-flagged or reported content. Use the detailed policy as the controlling description and avoid sensitive media when the exception does not fit the job.


## Common SwapFaces.ai problems


**Identity drifts during motion.** Test a shorter segment with a larger, clearer source face. Review profile turns, cuts and moments when the target passes behind a hand or object.


**The wrong person changes in a group.** Recheck face mapping and label every source identity before processing. Inspect all people, including background faces, after export.


**An unlimited plan still asks for credits.** Confirm which tool is covered. The official pricing page says other tools can remain credit-based even when video face swap is unlimited.


**Commercial use is unclear.** Preserve the plan and Terms shown at purchase, source licenses and documented consent. A commercial-license label does not clear third-party rights.


## How to evaluate SwapFaces.ai against another face-swap tool


Use the same permitted source portrait and the same five-to-ten-second target clip in each product. Include speech, a profile turn, a blink, changing light and a brief obstruction. Export at the same practical resolution, then review at normal speed and frame by frame.


Score identity stability, skin tone, hairline, teeth, glasses, occlusion, background faces and frame-to-frame flicker. Record every paid attempt, rejected output, processing delay and minute of manual repair. This produces a cost per accepted result instead of a misleading first-generation price.


For recurring work, repeat the sample with three materially different subjects. One favorable clip can show that a workflow works, but it cannot establish broad quality across ages, skin tones, camera angles and motion.

## Verdict


SwapFaces.ai has a defensible place for adults seeking one-time credits and long-form face-swap options. The service is adults-only and includes explicit-content tools, making it unsuitable for many teams. Test one representative job and verify current policies before committing sensitive media or recurring production.


## Frequently asked questions


###


**SwapFaces.ai offers signed-in free credits.** Its[pricing FAQ](https://www.swapfaces.ai/pricing) says users can claim credits by signing in daily, with a bonus after seven consecutive days. The public answer does not specify a fixed daily credit quantity. Check the account balance, selected tool and output charge before generating; daily credits do not make every video, HD export or unlimited plan free.


###


Safety depends on consent, source rights, current retention practices and how the output is used. Review the linked official privacy policy and avoid sensitive media when the published policy does not fit the job.


###


Magic Hour is a strong alternative for image, GIF and video face swap inside a broader creation suite. The best choice depends on media type, output quality, privacy, retries and accepted-output cost.


###


Only when you have the necessary rights to every source asset and person depicted, and the selected service plan permits the use. A tool cannot grant rights you do not already have.
